Claude/Claude Code logo: coral-orange (about #D97757-like) irregular radial starburst/asterisk beside a black high-contrast serif wordmark 'Claude'. Orange/coral plus radial burst is the Claude-adjacent territory.
Cursor logo: black isometric cube/hexagon with a cut-in arrow/cursor facet, heavy rounded-geometric uppercase wordmark; app icon is a light squircle with the black cube. Monochrome, hexagonal.

The Windsurf URL researched resolved to devin.ai/desktop; its collected logo is a black hexagon-cluster glyph plus a geometric sans 'Devin' wordmark. Brand relationship Windsurf/Devin not verified here (rebrand or acquisition not confirmed).
Cline logo: dark navy/black rounded-square robot-face glyph (two vertical pill eyes, antenna knob, side arrows) with a monospace uppercase wordmark 'CLINE'. Mascot plus monospace.
Continue logo: charcoal (#33323A) hexagonal ring built from isometric stripes/blocks plus lowercase geometric-sans wordmark 'continue'. Hexagon family; monochrome.

Gemini CLI: favicon/icon is a dark navy rounded square with a bold angular '>' prompt chevron, filled with a blue-to-violet-to-red gradient and a gradient border. Terminal prompt plus gradient territory. (The collected inline SVG was only a plain chevron UI icon, not the brand logo.)

GitHub Copilot research collected the GitHub Octocat icon (black circle, white cat silhouette) and a hamburger menu glyph, not a Copilot-specific mark; the Copilot mark itself was not captured and needs a manual reference.

Logo/favicon-tool competitors use single-letter or bright-multicolor marks: Brandmark icon is a black 'B' on yellow square; RealFaviconGenerator icon is a white 'R' on blue/yellow split square; Hatchful/Shopify is a green shopping-bag with 'S'; Figma icon is five-shape multicolor on black. Consumer logo makers lean on bright primaries and friendly sans.

Existing Markilo lockup: two black L-shaped corner brackets (top-left, bottom-right) framing a small orange square (#f45d2c), plus lowercase 'markilo' in a bold geometric grotesk (Space Grotesk 700 per caller brief). Rendered and viewed.

The existing Markilo accent #f45d2c (saturated red-orange) sits close to the Claude coral/orange territory and the existing mark is not a starburst. The accent is likely read as Claude-adjacent next to Claude Code, while the crop-corner shape is not. Based on visual comparison, not on measured hue distance.

Crowded visual territory among AI coding tools in the sample: (1) monochrome black marks on light/white (Cursor, Devin/Windsurf, Continue, Cline); (2) hexagon/isometric-cube forms (Cursor, Continue, Devin); (3) terminal prompt chevron '>' (Gemini CLI icon); (4) radial starburst/asterisk and coral-orange (Claude); (5) friendly robot/mascot (Cline, Octocat); (6) blue-violet-red gradient (Gemini CLI). Sample of about 8 tools, so 'crowded' is a pattern in this sample, not a census.

Open territory in the sample: none of the collected marks is a corner-bracket / crop-mark / registration-mark form, none uses a lowercase-only wordmark with a square-geometry glyph combined with a single orange accent on near-black, and no direct logo-tool uses a dark-first developer look (they use bright, friendly, multicolor consumer styling). Crop/registration marks are a print-design reference unrelated to AI-tool visual codes.

Looka (official site blocked, HTTP 403) per aggregator sites only: AI logo maker with one-time logo packages (about USD 20 basic PNG, about USD 65 premium with vector) and an annual Brand Kit subscription (about USD 96/yr, 300+ templates); figures vary between aggregators.

Category positioning gap: logo makers (Looka, Brandmark, Designs.ai, Canva, Adobe Express, Hatchful) are hosted, template/stock-icon based, consumer or SMB, and sell one-time or subscription packs; none (in what was read) offers local-first execution, originality/similarity evidence or deterministic geometry. Markilo's differentiation is process and evidence, not another generator. Competitor pages not exhaustively read.

Superpowers (Jesse Vincent / obra) is an open-source (MIT per blogs) agentic skills framework for Claude Code, also cited for Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI; the closest peer in the Claude Code plugin ecosystem. Known only through secondary blogs; its logo/identity was not examined.

In Esperanto the suffix -ilo marks an instrument/tool, and 'markilo' is an actual Esperanto word meaning 'marker' (felt-tip pen; also biological marker). So Markilo reads as 'the marking tool' - a real, fitting meaning, but it is an existing dictionary word (not coined). Sources are secondary dictionaries.

Web search for exact 'Markilo' and 'Markilo trademark software' found no company, product or brand using the name; only Esperanto dictionary hits and unrelated names (Marko...). Search engines are not clearance.
